visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with short dark hair, dressed in a textured beige sweater, exhales a large cloud of white smoke while looking thoughtfully to the side. The scene is indoors with warm, dim orange lighting, and a detailed carved wall panel is visible in the background setting. (2) The scene shifts to the same man in a bright, white-walled indoor studio, wearing a crisp white button-down shirt. He speaks expressively to the camera with frequent facial changes. Overlaid on the screen is a digital recording of an X post showing a grainy convenience store interior with a clerk and customer at the counter. (3) A 2D flat animation of a convenience store counter is shown with two characters: a clerk in green and a customer in pink. Speech bubbles appear above them to represent dialogue. The speaker's face intermittently reappears at the bottom, reacting to the animation with wide eyes and intense hand gestures. (4) The man reacts with shock, his face briefly turning black-and-white for dramatic effect. He points to social media comments displayed on screen, which feature Japanese text. Finally, he holds a yellow pointer and gestures towards the bottom of the screen, inviting viewers to leave a comment in a static white-walled room.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a low, ambient indoor room tone and the soft, airy sound of a deep exhalation. There is no music at this point, focusing purely on the quiet atmospheric sound of the individual's breathing in the room for two seconds. (2) A bright, mid-tempo upbeat BGM kicks in with a clear electronic piano melody. The main speaker's voice enters, exhibiting a high pitch, fast speech rate, and enthusiastic tone, articulating clearly in a mix of Japanese and Mandarin Chinese. (3) A hard cut introduces a secondary audio layer from a screen recording. A male voice yells in Japanese with high intensity and anger. Beneath this, the original cheerful BGM continues to play, creating a sharp contrast between the light music and aggressive shouting. (4) The main speaker resumes his narration. His voice modulates frequently between curious inquiry and exaggerated shock. A digital 'ding' sound effect triggers when animation text appears. The BGM remains steady with a major-mode tonality and clear percussive beat throughout the middle. (5) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect accompanies a visual transition. The speaker's voice reaches a peak of surprise, followed by a lighter, more conversational tone. A final 'sparkle' SFX sounds as the BGM fades out into a clean studio silence at the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video features a Japanese creator living in Taiwan sharing a culture shock experience regarding the extreme politeness expected in Japanese convenience stores. He reflects on how his time in Taiwan has changed his perspective on service etiquette.
